title: Delegated Codex child environment holds a duplicate case-variant variable, breaking PowerShell Env: enumeration
outcome: A delegated child's environment block on Windows holds each variable name once, ignoring case, so `Get-ChildItem Env:` and Env:-prefixed filters work in the child's shell.
acceptance: Identify the duplicated variable name pair in a delegated Codex child's environment on Windows (the exact names, and which layer adds each: TermAl spawn, Codex app-server, or the shell tool).

If TermAl's spawn adds the duplicate: TermAl deduplicates the environment case-insensitively before spawn on Windows, keeping one deterministic value, and a test pins it. If another layer adds it: the item records that layer with evidence and is handed to its owner.
`Get-ChildItem Env:ENGRAM*` succeeds in a fresh delegated Codex reviewer on Windows.
disposal_reason: Duplicate of the older w-6d42c3e614aa, which holds the 10-03 and 10-07 occurrences of the same `Get-ChildItem Env:` duplicate-key failure in a delegated Codex child. This item's three criteria were carried to it verbatim (its revision with reason citing coordinator concurrence eabca0f0), and this item's 10-08 occurrence (note 159371a2) was quoted on it.
